title: Add conversational-turn metrics and sequence-energy dashboard
author: Maya Patel
commits: feat(obs): capture per-turn boundaries and token timestamps (runtime instrumentation)
feat(obs): aggregate sequence-energy score and per-turn KV-cache-hit counters
chore(dash): add sequence-energy dashboard and turn-level SLO panels
test(obs): add unit tests for boundary detection and replay harness
docs: document new metrics and rollout guide
description: Motivation: multi-turn applications (chat assistants and conversational agents) surface tail behaviors that standard per-invocation metrics miss because the internal turn boundaries and token-phase energy are not explicitly represented. This PR introduces turn-level instrumentation, a lightweight 'sequence-energy' score per invocation, and a companion dashboard and alert gating rules. Implementation summary: 1) runtime: a heuristic but conservative turn_detector in Rust that emits turn_start/turn_end events with per-token timestamps and kv_cache_hit flags; 2) ingest: metrics_ingest.go was extended to consume turn events, produce aggregated metrics (turn.latency_ms, turn.token_count, turn.sequence_energy, turn.kv_hit_ratio) and a sampled histogram for sequence_energy per model+route; 3) dashboard: sequence_energy_dashboard.json visualizes distribution of sequence_energy by route, median per-turn latency, and an interactive replay link for sampled turn traces; 4) alerts: turn_slo_noisegate_rules.yaml implements an SLO noise-gating strategy that suppresses noisy per-invocation alerts unless cohort-level energy drift exceeds a threshold; 5) tests & docs: added replaybench, unit tests and documentation with rollout steps and fallback behavior. Backwards compatibility: if the turn detector is disabled via runtime flag the ingest falls back to existing invocation-level aggregations; no schema-breaking changes to metrics names. Observability implications: new cardinality dimension (turn_index) is intentionally avoided in primary backends; sequence_energy is summarized at route/model buckets. Testing & validation: local replaybench simulates multi-turn patterns and verifies metric alignment and KV cache attribution; CI runs added tests and linting. Rollout plan: staged rollout to Dedicated -> a small percentage of hosted traffic (5% canary) -> global, with feature flag to disable emission. Risks & mitigations: mis-detected turns could skew SLOs; mitigated by conservative detector and by using cohort baselines for alert gating. Related: ENG-1984 (turn-aware SLOs), ENG-2002 (kv attribution per-turn).
review_comments: Ethan Zhao (2026-02-22): This looks solid. A few questions: how expensive is the detector on p99 latency? Can we ensure metric emission doesn't block token generation?

Maya Patel (2026-02-22): The detector is async and runs on the inference worker's observer thread off the hot path; we measured <0.5ms p99 overhead on our internal microbench with batch size 8. Metrics emission uses batched protobufs so it won't block generation.
Riley Thompson (2026-02-24): The sequence_energy concept is interesting. Can you add a short note in docs about how it's computed and how operators should interpret it?

Maya Patel (2026-02-24): Added docs/observability/turn-metrics.md that details sequence_energy computation (token log-prob variance weighted by KV warmness heuristic) and examples of drift interpretation.
Priya Desai (2026-02-26): Alert gating rules look good. Recommend a 24-hour warmup window before the SLO gate flips to avoid transient noise triggering.
Maya Patel (2026-02-26): Added warmup_window: 24h and a canary config in the alert rule.
release_notes: Introduces turn-level observability and a 'sequence-energy' metric to better capture multi-turn conversational tails. Adds dashboard and SLO noise-gating rules. Backwards compatible when feature flag is disabled.
notes_on_rollout: Staged rollout: enable on Dedicated for 48h sanity -> 5% hosted canary for 72h -> increase to 25% then full. Feature flag: runtime.observability.turn_metrics.enabled. Monitor: turn.sequence_energy median and p95, kv_hit_ratio per-turn, and alert suppression rate.
testing_summary: Unit tests for turn_boundary detection and kv attribution added; replaybench simulates 3 canonical conversation patterns (short back-and-forth, long monologue, bursty user edits). CI: all tests passed; manual canary run validated dashboard values against raw traces.
implementation_notes: sequence_energy is computed as a sum over tokens of (token_logprob_variance * token_time_delta_ms_normalized) then normalized by token_count. This is intentionally opaque but documented with interpretation heuristics. Emitted metrics use existing metric names prefixed with turn. No new ingestion pipeline was added; aggregation reuses the same rollup workers with small extra CPU cost.
